name: direct binary Git-blob publication plus stale-ref recovery probe

readback.non_utf8_control: raw UTF-8 blob fetch failed at byte 0xff, consistent with actual non-text bytes

stale_X_update.result: 422 Update is not a fast forward

design_revision.before: Direct binary storage was shown on an isolated branch, but stale branch publication/retry semantics were not exercised.
design_revision.after: The isolated-branch substrate now has a live stale-ref negative control: force=false rejects a sibling commit after another sibling wins; fresh-head reconstruction and a descendant commit recover without changing the binary payload. This gives a bounded optimistic-concurrency pattern for atomic multi-file/binary publication without protected primary authority.

scope_limits: One unprotected role-local branch and tiny binary fixture; do not generalize to protected primary refs or multi-repository transactions.
Ref safety relies on force=false non-fast-forward rejection plus fresh reconstruction; it is not a compare-and-swap API with an explicit expected-old-SHA parameter.
Does not execute bytes or submit them to an unrelated binary-upload API.
